name: philiprehberger/docgen
description: Docgen is a document generation API. POST a template + data, get HTML, PDF, or DOCX back.  This spec covers the surface delivered through Phase 5 of the build: templates, versioning, field discovery, render submit (async + sync), polling, signed-URL download, and HTML/PDF/DOCX output. SDKs are generated from this spec; controllers conform to it.
